automated.summary: All 20 required leaves executed and passed under the VITEST discriminator - present AND NOT skipped AND NOT failed (D-0031) - because vitest exits 0 and marks an unmatched -t leaf skipped, so a name drift reports green having asserted nothing. Full frontend suite: 153 tests across 22 files, all passing. verify.py passes. The aggregate is proven by an INTEGRATION leaf, not only the helper: it asserts the aggregate response renders descendant VALUES from the statement already held AND issues no request, which is what decision 0024 requires and what a helper-only test could not have caught - a correct helper beside a labels-only or fetching renderer would have passed. /ask isolation is proven on BOTH halves: a grounded turn is not rendered there, and it is excluded from the priorTurns an ungrounded ask sends, so a grounded explanation cannot leak into an ungrounded request's context. All three optional statement fields gate grounding independently, so a response missing the metadata or the amounts cannot produce a request that is invalid at the server. Focus clears when the scope or pinned batches change, and a grounded explanation is cleared when a different statement is generated while ordinary Ask turns survive - without that an explanation of one plant's figure would sit against another's. DESIGN PASS (emil-design-eng and frontend-design genuinely applied, not merely attested) found two real defects, both fixed. The replaced notice was painted with the error palette and announced with role=alert, but decision 0025 is explicit that a replaced-but-present batch's figures are legitimate - so it told the user something had broken when nothing had, the same category mistake decision 0034 forbids for the Budget not-loaded state. It is now role=status with an advisory emerald-and-paper treatment that keeps its prominence through the left border without claiming breakage. And the new open-the-drill control had a scale(0.97) press feedback that was absent from the prefers-reduced-motion block every other button in globals.css is listed in; it now respects it. The numerics use tabular-nums and right alignment so the figures read as financial rather than chatty. ROUND 2 (security and performance both scored 0; all three defects were real and each was raised by more than one lens). The clearing rule had a REMOUNT HOLE: previousIdentity was component-local to MisReportView and started undefined, so the guard skipped clearing on the first statement any new instance saw - and since AskProvider outlives the route, navigating away and back then loading a different statement left the old explanation sitting against the new figures, exactly the defect the rule exists to prevent. The identity now lives in the PROVIDER, where the turns live, so a remount cannot reopen the hole. An in-flight askGrounded was also not invalidated - clearing only filtered turns already in state, so a pending response landed afterwards and re-added a grounded turn describing the OLD statement; it is now aborted as part of clearing. And two compatibility shims went: StatementView kept its own DrillPanelSelection and a fallback factory whenever onOpenDrill was absent, preserving the very ownership path the lift retires, and useOptionalAsk duplicated useAsk purely to suppress the missing-provider failure. onOpenDrill is now required, a missing provider fails loudly, and the 17 callers in drill-panel.test.tsx pass the lifted factory. That is the fourth shim this story has removed. Re-verified: 20/20 leaves pass, frontend 154/154 across 22 files, verify green. ROUND 3: the last arm of the clearing rule. mis-report-view.tsx early-returned when identity was undefined, and identity goes undefined whenever a RESOLVED statement is replaced by an unresolvable, refresh-required or failed result - so the return skipped both the provider synchronisation and the local focus clearing, and a grounded explanation survived with NO statement behind it at all. That is worse than the remount hole, because there are no figures on screen for it to be wrong about, only an explanation presented as though there were. An absent identity is now a clearing trigger rather than nothing-to-compare, and the dock falls back to its local message. Final: 20/20 leaves pass, frontend 155/155 across 22 files, verify green.
